description: Ministry of Labour & Labour Union Relations - Collective Agreement No. 40 of 2018, between Haycarb PLC and the Ceylon Mercantile, Industrial & General Workers Union (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a private company (Haycarb PLC) and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions governing employment terms, salaries, bonuses, allowances, and dispute resolution procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the formal publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for employment relations.
